payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed gating mechanism is specifically designed to effectively handle one-sentence bags, addressing the limitations of selective attention in such cases.

claims.text: The proposed gating mechanism is competent to handle one-sentence bags, preventing noise representation from being propagated even when the only sentence is wrongly labeled.
The gating mechanism performs stably and effectively even if only one sentence appears in a bag, maintaining consistency across training examples.
The model shows improved performance on one-sentence bags compared to selective attention methods, which are vulnerable to such cases.
